def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Greedy placement (hardest models first, each to the GPU yielding the
    lowest resulting KVPR), followed by a local-search refinement that
    repeatedly moves a model off the current worst-KVPR GPU when doing so
    lowers the maximum KVPR.
    """

    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True)

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    shared_kv = [GPU_MEM_SIZE for _ in range(gpu_num)]
    weighted_req_rate = [0.0 for _ in range(gpu_num)]

    def kvpr(gpu_id):
        if shared_kv[gpu_id] >= GPU_MEM_SIZE:
            return 0.0
        return weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] / shared_kv[gpu_id]

    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx = None
        best_ratio = float('inf')

        for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
            remaining = shared_kv[gpu_id] - model.model_size
            if remaining > 0:
                new_ratio = (weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / remaining
                if new_ratio < best_ratio:
                    best_ratio = new_ratio
                    best_idx = gpu_id

        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB on any GPU. "
                f"Remaining per-GPU memory: {shared_kv}"
            )

        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        weighted_req_rate[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        shared_kv[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    # Local search: move or swap models to reduce the maximum KVPR
    def try_apply(model, src, dst, swap_model=None):
        """Simulate moving model src->dst (optionally swapping with swap_model).
        Applies the change if it lowers the max KVPR; reverts otherwise."""
        cur_max = max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num))
        if swap_model is None:
            if shared_kv[dst] - model.model_size <= 0:
                return False
            weighted_req_rate[src] -= model.req_rate / model.slo
            shared_kv[src] += model.model_size
            weighted_req_rate[dst] += model.req_rate / model.slo
            shared_kv[dst] -= model.model_size
        else:
            if (shared_kv[src] + model.model_size - swap_model.model_size <= 0
                    or shared_kv[dst] + swap_model.model_size - model.model_size <= 0):
                return False
            weighted_req_rate[src] += swap_model.req_rate / swap_model.slo - model.req_rate / model.slo
            shared_kv[src] += swap_model.model_size - model.model_size
            weighted_req_rate[dst] += model.req_rate / model.slo - swap_model.req_rate / swap_model.slo
            shared_kv[dst] += model.model_size - swap_model.model_size
        if max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num)) < cur_max:
            if swap_model is None:
                placement[src].remove(model)
                placement[dst].append(model)
            else:
                placement[src].remove(model)
                placement[src].append(swap_model)
                placement[dst].remove(swap_model)
                placement[dst].append(model)
            return True
        # revert
        if swap_model is None:
            weighted_req_rate[src] += model.req_rate / model.slo
            shared_kv[src] -= model.model_size
            weighted_req_rate[dst] -= model.req_rate / model.slo
            shared_kv[dst] += model.model_size
        else:
            weighted_req_rate[src] += model.req_rate / model.slo - swap_model.req_rate / swap_model.slo
            shared_kv[src] += model.model_size - swap_model.model_size
            weighted_req_rate[dst] += swap_model.req_rate / swap_model.slo - model.req_rate / model.slo
            shared_kv[dst] += swap_model.model_size - model.model_size
        return False

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        worst = max(range(gpu_num), key=kvpr)
        if not placement[worst] or kvpr(worst) == 0.0:
            break
        improved = False
        # Move phase: try moving any model off the worst GPU
        for model in sorted(placement[worst],
                            key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
            for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
                if gpu_id != worst and try_apply(model, worst, gpu_id):
                    improved = True
                    break
            if improved:
                break
        if improved:
            continue
        # Swap phase: exchange a model on the worst GPU with one elsewhere
        for model in sorted(placement[worst],
                            key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
            for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
                if gpu_id == worst:
                    continue
                for other in list(placement[gpu_id]):
                    if try_apply(model, worst, gpu_id, swap_model=other):
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
            if improved:
                break
        if not improved:
            break

    return placement

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test the algorithm

    from evaluator import calculate_kvcache_pressure
    from evaluator import safe_float

    test_cases = generate_test_gpu_models()

def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """
    Greedy placement (hardest models first, each to the GPU yielding the
    lowest resulting KVPR), followed by a local-search refinement that
    repeatedly moves a model off the current worst-KVPR GPU when doing so
    lowers the maximum KVPR.
    """

    sorted_models = sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True)

    placement = {gpu_id: [] for gpu_id in range(gpu_num)}
    shared_kv = [GPU_MEM_SIZE for _ in range(gpu_num)]
    weighted_req_rate = [0.0 for _ in range(gpu_num)]

    def kvpr(gpu_id):
        if shared_kv[gpu_id] >= GPU_MEM_SIZE:
            return 0.0
        return weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] / shared_kv[gpu_id]

    for model in sorted_models:
        best_idx = None
        best_ratio = float('inf')

        for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
            remaining = shared_kv[gpu_id] - model.model_size
            if remaining > 0:
                new_ratio = (weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] + model.req_rate / model.slo) / remaining
                if new_ratio < best_ratio:
                    best_ratio = new_ratio
                    best_idx = gpu_id

        if best_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unable to place model of size {model.model_size} GB on any GPU. "
                f"Remaining per-GPU memory: {shared_kv}"
            )

        placement[best_idx].append(model)
        weighted_req_rate[best_idx] += model.req_rate / model.slo
        shared_kv[best_idx] -= model.model_size

    # Local search: move models away from the worst GPU to reduce max KVPR
    for _ in range(len(models)):
        worst = max(range(gpu_num), key=kvpr)
        if not placement[worst] or kvpr(worst) == 0.0:
            break
        cur_max = max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num))
        moved = False
        # try moving the model with the largest pressure contribution first
        for model in sorted(placement[worst],
                            key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
            for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):
                if gpu_id == worst:
                    continue
                if shared_kv[gpu_id] - model.model_size <= 0:
                    continue
                # simulate move
                weighted_req_rate[worst] -= model.req_rate / model.slo
                shared_kv[worst] += model.model_size
                weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] += model.req_rate / model.slo
                shared_kv[gpu_id] -= model.model_size
                new_max = max(kvpr(g) for g in range(gpu_num))
                if new_max < cur_max:
                    placement[worst].remove(model)
                    placement[gpu_id].append(model)
                    moved = True
                    break
                # revert
                weighted_req_rate[worst] += model.req_rate / model.slo
                shared_kv[worst] -= model.model_size
                weighted_req_rate[gpu_id] -= model.req_rate / model.slo
                shared_kv[gpu_id] += model.model_size
            if moved:

        if not moved:
            # Swap phase: exchange models between worst GPU and others
            swapped = False
            for model in sorted(placement[worst],
                                key=lambda m: m.req_rate / m.slo, reverse=True):
                for gpu_id in range(gpu_num):

                    for other in list(placement[gpu_id]):

                                or shared_kv[gpu_id] + other.model_size - model.model_size <= 0):

                        shared_kv[worst] += other.model_size - model.model_size

                        shared_kv[gpu_id] += other.model_size - model.model_size
                    if swapped:
